what: Once, when the top edge of a section name crosses the 60% line from the top of the screen — a 1px vertical line in the center (60px) is drawn downward from 10px above in .3s, and the name words below the line, hidden beneath the cell, rise in .3s after a .1s delay and darken from opacity .1 to 1 in .5s after a .3s delay (cubic-bezier(.39,.575,.565,1)) — a header where a vertical line descends in every section to open the name

options.ratio: At what fraction from the top of the screen the line is crossed and it stands, default .6
options.--fx-line: Vertical line length (css), default 60px — phone original 30px
options.--fx-line-color: Line color (css), default half --kf-dim and half background
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Name field (required) — if there is no word marker, the text is wrapped in word chunks

from.where: index.html · list.html section name. Original .cmn-border-vertical-ttl (:before 60px · translateY(-10px) scaleY(0) .3s, __txt span translateY(100%) · opacity .1 → .3s .1s · .5s .3s, js-scroll-animation ratio .6)
